# Capital City Bank Group, Inc. Increases Cash Dividend


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_16ce711c3321ef2180f42131c0bd244a/ccbg/news/2026-11-19_Capital_City_Bank_Group_Inc_Increases_Cash_247.pdf) November 19, 2026 4:15pm EST


TALLAHASSEE, Fla., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Capital City Bank Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCBG) declared a quarterly cash dividend on its common stock of $0.28 per share. It represents a 3.7% increase over the prior quarter dividend of $0.27 per share. The dividend produces an annualized rate of $1.12 per common share and is payable on December 17, 2026, to shareowners of record as of December 3, 2026. The annualized dividend yield is 2.25% based on a closing stock price of $49.88 on November 18, 2026.


**About Capital City Bank Group, Inc.**
Capital City Bank Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: CCBG) is one of the largest publicly traded financial holding companies headquartered in Florida and has approximately $4.4 billion in assets. We provide a full range of banking services, including traditional deposit and credit services, mortgage banking, asset management, trust, merchant services, bankcards, and securities brokerage services. Our bank subsidiary, Capital City Bank, was founded in 1895 and has 62 banking offices, 27 mortgage offices and 107 ATMs/ITMs in Florida, Georgia and Alabama. For more information about Capital City Bank Group, Inc., visit[www.ccbg.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=w1kkdOR0jRhAfOWy4pz82YkqG1QurxRWki5EBuFuFzhek6EW01hIyktiO-w85MRFutBT2VlzeEcnyIdS8mx9QA==) .
